name: IShopMeta - Mall
summary: iShopMeta is a next-gen VR shopping experience built for Meta Quest, turning online shopping into an immersive, interactive world. Instead of scrolling through flat pages, you walk through virtual stores, explore curated displays, and interact with products in 3D. Try on outfits and jewelry with realistic virtual try-ons that let you see how pieces fit, shine, and move—no guessing, no awkward sizing surprises.
